source: Create one NEW top-down Chinese ink-wash pond turtle game sprite, using supplied turtle07 only as a general pigment/style reference, not the same turtle. Full dorsal overhead view, head points straight up and tail down. Graceful natural rounded oval shell with clearly readable softly irregular scutes, subtle diluted warm-gray ink washes, a few firm dark brush accents at rim and eyes; expressive economical hand-painted Chinese brushwork, no photorealistic scales, no cartoon sticker, no vector icon, no ornate details. Medium detail, beautiful quiet traditional ink painting. Shell proportion natural, four short strong paddle-like terrapin legs with distinct tiny toes extend diagonally away from shell, visibly separated from shell contour, clean joint boundaries. Head with elegant stripe marks and small alert eyes, short neck naturally attached. Anatomically normal freshwater turtle, not a sea turtle or tortoise. Centered composition, generous transparent margin so claws/tail not clipped. High-detail ink edges and pigment texture suitable for later high-resolution game master. Body and appendages physically complete: no accidental transparent cracks crossing shell or leg roots. Exterior truly transparent alpha, no paper, white/gray/checkerboard, water, splash, shadow, frame, text, calligraphy, seals. Pose simple neutral and suitable for puppet cutout: shell stable, head/four legs/tail independently movable later. One entire assembled turtle only.

repairs.shell: Precise shell-only edit of this exact new ink turtle08. Keep exact shell pattern, shape, pigment texture, canvas framing and pixel registration. Output only a complete closed oval shell, no head, neck, feet or tail. Fill the tiny regions behind four limbs with continuous softly dark natural rim. Shell top around(540,330), bottom(540,1235), left(160,770), right(920,800) on 1086x1448 reference canvas. No scaly limb fragments on rim. Do not redesign or smooth away brush texture. Original inner scutes identical. True transparent alpha background, no paper or checkerboard, labels or scene.
repairs.legs: Precise puppet cutout animation repair edit of this exact turtle08. Output ONLY THE FOUR LEGS. Preserve original foot/toe position and silhouette on 1086x1448 canvas: upper-left around(220,410), upper-right(870,410), lower-left(230,1185), lower-right(850,1185). Remove shell/head/tail. Extend each leg inwards into a long natural gray ink upper limb hidden behind shell: upper-left extends to(470,600), upper-right to(620,600), lower-left to(470,1000), lower-right to(620,1000). Each leg is one continuous complete shape without gaps, wider rounded upper stump; leave four legs disconnected from each other. Natural diluted ink and soft sparse mottles matching source, not longitudinal stripes or shell scute tiles. Exact original foot pose and canvas placement, no replacement designs. Four legs on truly transparent background. No scene/text/white gray checkerboard or shadows.
